frontHtml: Why is a rise in myocardial oxygen demand met by more coronary flow rather than more extraction?
backHtml: Resting myocardial oxygen extraction is already about 70–75%, so extraction can rise little; metabolic arteriolar dilation raises flow instead.

frontHtml: STEMI with primary PCI available promptly: which reperfusion strategy?
backHtml: Primary PCI (fibrinolysis only when timely PCI is not available).
